headline: Guidance trajectory eyed

highlights: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating HOLD HOLD Target Price 504 567 Sales (INR mn) 14,804 16,378 14,732 16,297 % Chng. 0.5 0.5 EBITDA (INR mn) 1,724 2,169 1,781 2,231 % Chng.

While TCIEXP IN’s volumes have started registering mid-single digit growth from 3QFY26 onwards with price hike ranging from ~0.5-3.4%; the operating leverage benefit has failed to materialize fully as EBITDA margins have remained range bound at ~10% odd levels amid cost inflation (fuel, wage etc).
We expect volume/realization CAGR of 8%/2% over the next 3 years with EBITDA margin of 10.7%/11.6%/13.3% in FY27E/FY28E/FY29E respectively.
Given persistent growth and margin headwinds, we cut our target multiple to 15x Sep-28E EPS (earlier 16.5x) and retain HOLD on the stock with a TP of INR504.
